opportunities.title: EXIF-assisted observation capture
opportunities.detail: Prefill coordinates/time from photograph EXIF with explicit user confirmation; provenance tag exif-gps. Never auto-writes geometry.
opportunities.evidence: Engineering inference from §5/§8 provenance contract; no external pin needed.

opportunities.title: Direct device-to-device exchange
opportunities.detail: Same exchange-card + revision/merge machinery over local Wi-Fi/USB; removes manual bundle hand-off. Conflict UX unchanged.
opportunities.status: deferred; exchange-card format already defined in §6.2 keeps this cheap
opportunities.evidence: Design inference grounded in P2 (Syncthing) precedent.

opportunities.title: Hosted exchange service (later)
opportunities.detail: Pull-based sync over the revision log; requires abandoning the v1 no-accounts rule; conflict UI unchanged.
opportunities.evidence: Brief lists hosted service as later opportunity.

opportunities.title: Broader map sources
opportunities.detail: MBTiles adapter is source-agnostic; each new source is primarily a licensing review (see §9), not new rendering code.

opportunities.title: Assist-only automated classification
opportunities.detail: Photo/audio classification suggestions with mandatory human commit; never auto-edits records.

alternatives.title: QGIS profile + offline-editing workflow instead of custom app
alternatives.detail: QGIS bundles PROJ/GDAL (P1) and GeoPackage support (S17); less new code, stronger CRS ergonomics. Trade-offs: no built-in two-copy merge with the §6 contract, plugin burden, heavy packaging for tablets.
alternatives.status: viable alternative; recommended as fast first deployment only if the group already runs QGIS

alternatives.title: GeoPackage/SpatiaLite on-disk format instead of plain SQLite + R*Tree
alternatives.detail: Better GIS interop; costs native-lib packaging and change tracking is informative-only (last_change 'should be treated as informative'), so content-hash invalidation still required.
alternatives.status: kept as lead; v1 uses plain SQLite+R*Tree

unresolved_dependencies.title: ODbL produced-works boundary for shared bundles
unresolved_dependencies.detail: Whether group-shared bundles containing an OSM-derived basemap trigger share-alike for anything beyond the basemap file, given observations are the group's own data. Requires license review against the group's sharing practice.

unresolved_dependencies.title: PROJ datum-grid availability offline
unresolved_dependencies.detail: Which datum transformations require grid files and PROJ's exact failure mode when a grid is absent were not pinned in this stage. v1 must detect and fail loudly naming the missing grid.
unresolved_dependencies.bounded_fallback: Restrict v1 to null transformations (identical datums) + flagged loud failures otherwise.

unresolved_dependencies.title: GeoPackage storage option (Alt-B)
unresolved_dependencies.detail: Preserved: interop path with explicit informative-only change tracking.

unresolved_dependencies.title: Vector-MBTiles rendering cost on 4-core/8 GB
unresolved_dependencies.detail: Dense vector tiles may strain the render budget; raster MBTiles is the bounded fallback.
unresolved_dependencies.evidence: [S12] allows both formats; no measurement made (U4).

unresolved_dependencies.title: Mapeo-style CRDT realtime sync
unresolved_dependencies.detail: Real-time collaboration later; would need an engine redesign beyond the revision log; kept as a research lead only, not claimed supported.
unresolved_dependencies.status: open; no primary source pinned in this stage (do not treat as evidence-backed)

unresolved_dependencies.title: Unreachable primary pages
unresolved_dependencies.detail: docs.getodk.org (3 attempts) and operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/ (3 attempts) returned boundary transport errors (OSError). Substitutions captured: getodk/collect repo metadata + README; OSM copyright 'Additional services' section. Retry both from a permitted network to tighten pins.

unresolved_dependencies.title: First release containing GDAL PR #3311 not byte-verified
unresolved_dependencies.detail: Timeline inference says 3.3.x (merge 2020-12-22; 3.2.0 released 2020-11-02 [S6a]; 3.3.0 released 2021-05-03 [S6b]); blob presence in v3.3.0 unverified (U6).
unresolved_dependencies.bounded_fallback: Cite the PR merge commit directly when relying on the mechanism.
